Role reports to: Lead Financial Analyst      Location: Latin America, Brazil, Sao Paulo, Sao Jose dos Campos      Work Location: Hybrid      What you will do    This position will play a critical role in managing Neutrogena’s (NTG) marketing spend forecasting, financial planning, actuals reporting, and business performance analysis. This role partners closely with Marketing, Media, Sales, and Finance leadership to deliver accurate forecasts, provide actionable business insights, identify risks and opportunities, and support strategic decision-making. The ideal candidate combines strong financial acumen, analytical rigor, and business partnership skills to influence outcomes and drive continuous process improvement within a matrixed environment. This role reports into the Lead Financial Analyst supporting NTG Cleansing/Acne, Hair, and Body Categories.      Responsibilities (including, but not limited to):      Marketing Spend Forecasting & Financial Consolidations Own and maintain the Total Neutrogena BME (Brand Marketing Expense) tracker, ensuring accuracy and completeness across all reporting cycles. Lead monthly forecasting, annual planning, and One Stream submissions for the Neutrogena portfolio. Manage centrally held expenses, including media, allocations, and agency fees, while communicating updates to business partners and finance team. Ensure accurate integration of SAP actuals, forecast updates, account mappings, and structural or methodology changes. Partner monthly with Marketing and Media teams to align on budget estimates and spending expectations. Analyze month-over-month forecast changes and proactively identify risks and opportunities impacting full-year performance.    Actuals Management & Financial Reporting Oversee BME spend actuals reporting and validation processes. Monitor open purchase orders and partner with stakeholders to ensure timely review and spend visibility. Validate accruals through analysis of forecast versus actual activity and investigate potential discrepancies. Ensure spend is accurately recorded within appropriate accounts and profit centers, coordinating reclasses as needed. Partner with Controllership to ensure actuals are complete, accurate, and fully reconciled. Provide clear explanations of spending variances, business drivers, and emerging financial risks and opportunities.    Category Finance & Commercial Partnership Support assigned categories through the end-to-end Integrated Business Planning (IBP) process. Partner with Marketing, Demand, and Customer Strategy teams to develop forecasts and evaluate commercial opportunities and risks. Communicate key business drivers, forecast changes, and financial implications to stakeholders and leadership. Prepare monthly close commentary and performance analysis, translating financial results into actionable insights. Develop a deep understanding of category performance and serve as a trusted business partner beyond financial reporting.    Process Improvement & Operational Excellence Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and enhance forecasting and reporting processes. Drive continuous improvement initiatives that increase efficiency, accuracy, and decision-making effectiveness. Support ad hoc analyses, strategic projects, and other responsibilities as assigned.    What we are looking for      Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or Business Administration Solid experience in Finance and/or Accounting role Excellent written and verbal English communication skills are required. This role is highly stakeholder-facing and involves regular interaction with U. S. business partners, senior leadership, and cross-functional teams. Experience in FP& A, commercial finance, brand finance, or related analytical roles    Nice to Have: Consumer Packaged Goods experience is highly desirable Professional accounting designation (CA, CMA, CGA, CPA) is an asset    Knowledge & Technical Competency Requirements: Advanced proficiency in Excel and financial reporting tools Experience with financial systems such as SAP and One Stream preferred Demonstrated track-record in influencing business partners with fact-based data Demonstrated strong analytical skills and application of technical accounting knowledge, including knowledge of financial statements, margin analysis, cost optimization, etc. Proven ability to work through ambiguity and manage change effectively Demonstrated leadership skills and ability to work effectively as part of a team    If you are an individual with a disability, please check our Disability Assistance page for information on how to request an accommodation.

Sólido background técnico em engenharia de software e arquitetura de soluções em nuvem (familiaridade com ambientes Azure). Experiência prática avançada com frameworks de orquestração de IA, como Lang Chain, e protocolos de integração (ex: Model Context Protocol). Vivência no consumo, otimização e produtização de APIs de LLMs comerciais e open-source. vagas.title: Environment, health and safety coordinator joinville

Join us at Orbia Building & Infrastructure Amanco Wavin: Where purpose comes to life.    You’re purpose driven. Growth minded. Ready to stretch your potential. Welcome to Orbia’s Building & Infrastructure business, Wavin, where our purpose ‘to advance life around the world’ drives our entire global team.      Every day, we are thinking big and working smart to solve some of the toughest challenges impacting the world. Whether it’s facilitating clean drinking water for communities, creating climate resilient cities, or designing more comfortable living spaces, we never settle for “good enough” when there’s an opportunity to make life better.      Where purpose comes to life, it changes lives. This is what we work for. How about you?        We are currently looking for a Head of Environment, Health, and Safety to join us at our team in Joinville . If you want to make a difference and work for a purpose-led company, please read on.      The Role  This person will be responsible for leading and ensuring the national management of Industrial Safety, Environment and Occupational Health programs and activities.      Your Responsibilities: Guarantee compliance with applicable legal requirements on environmental, industrial safety and occupational health issues. Achieve zero accidents resulting from work activities. Reduce the incidence of occupational diseases. Establish action plans in Industrial Safety, Environment and Occupational Health (HSE).    Your Profile:   You have a degree in a relevant field such as Engineering, Safety and Hygiene, Environment, health sciences, or similar fields. Desirable: Postgraduate in Safety and Hygiene, Environment, health sciences.   You have +5 years of experience as a leader (supervisor, coordinator) in Safety and Hygiene, Environment & health in manufacturing industry.   English proficiency, we will have our interview in English. The position requires preparing reports, attending audits and meetings in English.   You are a teamplayer, motivator and excellent communicator with an entreprenaurial drive.      What Orbia Building & Infrastructure offers    Do you want to make a difference by working with a purpose? Count on a warm welcome at Orbia Building & Infrastructure (Wavin)! Here we take responsibility for each other and our company. We stay brave in pursuing calculated risks that fuel innovation. And we embrace diversity in perspectives, skills and talents to transform the way we work and the impact we have on the world. Above all we encourage all our employees to develop their talents and to become the best version of themselves. Together, as a strong team, we grow and deliver on our purpose every day. Orbia B& I is the place to be if you truly wish to make an impact. In addition to working with an enthusiastic, professional team in an international environment, we offer a competitive compensation and benefit package.      Organization    Orbia’s Building & Infrastructure business, Wavin, is an innovative solutions provider for the global building and infrastructure industry. Backed by more than 60 years of product development experience, we advance life around the world by building healthy, sustainable environments for global citizens. Whether it’s to improve the distribution of clean drinking water, to make sanitation accessible for everyone, to create climate resilient cities, or to design comfortable living spaces, Orbia B& I collaborates with municipal leaders, engineers, contractors, and installers to help future-proof communities, buildings and homes. Orbia B& I has 11,000+ employees and 65 production sites worldwide, serving over 80 countries through a global sales and distribution network. Our key commercial brands are: Wavin, Amanco Wavin, Pavco Wavin, Plastigama Wavin, and Bow Wavin.      Orbia Building & Infrastructure is part of Orbia – a company driven by a shared purpose: to advance life around the world. Orbia operates in several sectors including: Polymer Solutions (Vestolit and Alphagary), Building and Infrastructure (Wavin), Precision Agriculture (Netafim), Connectivity Solutions (Dura-Line) and Fluor and Energy Materials (Koura). These five Orbia business groups have a collective focus on expanding access to health and wellness, reinventing the future of cities and homes, ensuring food and water security, connecting communities to information and accelerating a circular economy with basic and advanced materials, specialty products and innovative solutions. Orbia has a global team of over 24,000 employees, commercial activities in more than 100 countries and operations in over 50, with headquarters in Boston, Mexico City, Amsterdam and Tel Aviv. The company generated $8.2 billion in revenue in 2023.

Key Responsibilities   End-to-End Logistics Operations   – Oversee the full chain from port arrival, customs clearance, container pick-up, inland transport, VMI warehousing, order outbound, to final delivery, and close exceptions effectively. Track vessel schedules, terminal status, and capacity; coordinate with forwarders, brokers, carriers, and customs to ensure smooth and compliant clearance; handle contingencies such as inspections, port congestion, and demurrage. Plan optimal routes and transport modes, monitor shipments in transit, and quickly respond to delays, damage, or rejections with emergency plans.   VMI Warehouse Lifecycle Management   – Manage receiving plans, inbound inspection, put-away, inventory control, cycle counts, and annual physical counts to ensure WMS/ERP data accuracy and physical inventory alignment. Maintain inventory health by handling damaged, mis-shipped, slow-moving, or obsolete goods, and propose improvement plans. Ensure outbound shipments meet customer requirements for timing, packaging, labeling, and batch control to support JIT delivery.   Sales Collaboration & Customer Service   – Act as the logistics point of contact, closely partnering with local sales teams to provide early feasibility assessments, lead-time, and cost commitments for orders and projects. Interface with end customers, synchronize logistics milestones, resolve delivery issues, and enhance customer experience. Collect market intelligence and front-end needs to continuously refine logistics strategies and service standards.   Local Resource & Supplier Management   – Build and maintain a reliable local network of service providers (customs brokers, trucking fleets, warehouses, terminals, clearance agents, bonded warehouses). Have strong sourcing and price comparison skills. Stay updated on local port rules, customs policies, freight rates, road restrictions, holiday impacts, and other critical information.   Logistics Solution Design & Cost Control   – Independently design tailor-made logistics solutions for key accounts or major projects, covering mode selection, route planning, warehousing/distribution strategy, risk contingencies, and cost estimation. Set regional logistics budgets, monitor port charges, clearance fees, transport costs, and warehouse expenses, and drive cost reduction and process optimization. Provide operational analysis and improvement reports to support headquarters’ decision-making.   Compliance, Risk & System Building   – Ensure all operations comply with local customs, trade, foreign exchange, tax, safety, and other regulatory requirements. Establish regional SOPs, exception handling mechanisms, and contingency plans to enhance team standardization and resilience. Regularly report risk points, improvement measures, and execution results.   Data Reporting & System Maintenance   – Produce regular KPI reports covering inbound timeliness, outbound accuracy, inventory accuracy, on-time delivery, exception rate, cost achievement, etc. Maintain logistics system data to ensure accuracy and traceability, supporting digital operations.     Qualifications    Basic Requirements    Bachelor’s degree or above (full-time) 5+ years of hands-on logistics operations and management experience   Deep knowledge of the full cycle: customs clearance, land transport, warehousing, and cross-border delivery   Must have   experience in VMI/HUB warehouse management     Core Competencies    Strong local logistics network and connections with government/port/service providers; ability to access real-time information quickly   Capable of independently designing logistics solutions, resolving complex issues, and working effectively under pressure   Excellent cross-functional communication, sales coordination, customer engagement, and commercial negotiation skills

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS). About the Company   : Working for a global provider of network test, monitoring and assurance solutions for telecommunications, cloud, enterprises, first responders, military, aerospace, and railway. A leader in light management technologies for 3D sensing, anti-counterfeiting, consumer electronics, industrial, automotive, government and aerospace applications. Employees working on this project are passionate about supporting customer success and we welcome people who bring their best every day to the company – to question, to collaborate and to push for solutions that will delight our customers.     About the Role   : We are seeking a Principal/Staff-level FPGA Engineer — a recognized technical authority — to own FPGA architecture for our state-of-the-art Communications Test & Measurement products. You will work closely with  Finance, Accounting, Procurement, and cross-functional stakeholders   to ensure the Workday Financials platform remains stable, scalable, and continuously optimized.   This is an ideal opportunity for an experienced Workday Financials professional who can work independently, solve complex problems, and provide hands-on expertise across multiple Financials domains.   Key Responsibilities   Provide hands-on  configuration, administration, and production support   across Workday Financials.   Troubleshoot system issues, investigate defects, and provide timely and effective resolutions.   Partner with Finance, Accounting, Procurement, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into scalable Workday solutions.   Support multiple Financials domains and adapt to changing business priorities.   Design, configure, and optimize Workday solutions with a focus on scalability, maintainability, and long-term platform health.   Deliver system enhancements, optimizations, and continuous improvement initiatives.   Collaborate with technical and functional teams on  reporting, integrations, and platform enhancements   .   Support strategic Finance transformation initiatives and future Workday capabilities.   Maintain clear and accurate documentation for configurations, business processes, and solution designs.   Work effectively in a fast-paced and collaborative environment with stakeholders across U.S. time zones.    Required Qualifications  8–10 years of hands-on Workday Financials experience.    Strong understanding of  end-to-end financial processes within Workday   .   Proven experience supporting both  production environments and project-based initiatives   .   Ability to work independently and effectively in a fast-paced and sometimes ambiguous environment.   Strong problem-solving, analytical, and systems-thinking skills.   Demonstrated expertise across multiple Workday Financials domains.    Priority Workday Financials Areas   Highest Priority    Financial Accounting   Expenses   Business Assets    Secondary Priority    Banking & Settlement    Nice to Have    VNDLY experience    Lower Priority    Procurement experience — the organization is gradually phasing this area out.    What Success Looks Like   In this role, success means you:   Seamlessly support multiple Workday Financials domains based on business priorities.   Reduce the production support backlog and improve responsiveness to Finance stakeholders.   Deliver  scalable, maintainable solutions   rather than short-term fixes.   Resolve issues efficiently while minimizing business disruption.   Become a trusted extension of the core Workday team.   Contribute to continuous improvement and long-term Finance transformation initiatives.    Why Aspire?  Join a  Remote-First   organization.   Work alongside exceptional technology professionals from around the world.   Access continuous technical and professional development opportunities.   Gain international exposure by collaborating with global technology leaders.   Receive nursery reimbursement benefits.   Participate in virtual and onsite international technology conferences.   Work within an IT environment aligned with rigorous security and compliance standards, including  ISO and SOC frameworks   .

vagas.title: Gerente de Vendas Regional (Sul)
vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Gerente de Vendas Regional (Sul) em santa catarina. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Na Dori | Ferrara, Ferrero, Fox’s Burton’s Companies e The Fine Biscuits Company, somos reconhecidos e amados por pessoas de todas as gerações pela alegria que compartilhamos com elas – uma alegria feita pelas nossas pessoas. Junte-se a nós e descubra um mundo cheio de possibilidades, onde sua paixão encontrará o seu lugar.   A Dori | Ferrara é uma das maiores empresas de doces e snacks do Brasil! Há mais de seis décadas, com um time de mais de 3000 colaboradores, produzimos produtos que acompanham gerações e fazem parte da história e das lembranças de milhões de famílias, com marcas icônicas como Gomets®, Yogurte 100®, Pettiz® e Disqueti®.    Em 2023, iniciamos um novo capítulo ao nos tornarmos parte da Ferrara Candy Company, líder número 1 em balas e gomas nos Estados Unidos, com marcas mundialmente conhecidas como NERDS®, Brach’s®, Jelly Belly®, SweeTARTS®, Laffy Taffy®, and Trolli®. E, na França, a Carambar & Co conquistou gerações de clientes fiéis graças ao apelo atemporal de marcas icônicas de doces e chocolates, como Carambar, Lutti, Krema, Poulain, Vichy e Terry’s.    Com essa união, somos mais de 9.000 colaboradores e uma rede com mais de 30 unidades, garantindo nossa presença global.    Gerente de Vendas Regional (Sul)    O(a)  Gerente de Vendas Regional   é responsável por traduzir a estratégia de vendas em resultados concretos no território, liderando equipes, fortalecendo relacionamentos com clientes e parceiros, e garantindo o crescimento sustentável do negócio na região atendida.    Localidade:   Florianópolis - SC    Reporta a:   Head de Vendas    Modelo de trabalho:   Presencial (Em campo)   Contamos com você para:    Liderar, desenvolver e engajar a equipe de vendas da região, definindo metas e acompanhando indicadores de performance;   Elaborar e executar o plano comercial regional, alinhado às diretrizes estratégicas da área de Vendas;   Monitorar resultados de vendas, market share e rentabilidade, propondo ações corretivas quando necessário e visando sempre otimizar os resultados;   Realizar visitas periódicas a clientes e pontos de venda, desenvolvendo com clientes-chave e fortalecendo o relacionamento com eles;   Analisar dados de vendas e mercado utilizando ferramentas para embasar decisões estratégicas;   Gerenciar o orçamento comercial da região, direcionando recursos de forma estratégica e com foco na maximização de resultados;   Identificar novas oportunidades de expansão de mercado e reportar resultados e projeções à liderança.     Do que você precisa para fazer a diferença:    Formação superior completa;   Experiência em gestão de equipes comerciais, preferencialmente em atuação regional ou de campo;   Vivência em negociação com grandes contas regionais ou nacionais;   Conhecimentos em Excel ao nível avançado, bem como familiaridade com ferramentas de Business Intelligence (Power BI ou similares) e Scanntech;   Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes dentro da região Sul do Brasil.     O que nós oferecemos:    Na Dori | Ferrara, nos orgulhamos de prover aos nossos colaboradores:    Programa de Participação nos Resultados (PPR)  Assistência médica   Assistência odontológica   Dr Dori (telemedicina)  Seguro de vida   Totalpass   Automóvel   Auxílio combustível   Vale refeição   Vale alimentação   Vale Natal   Vale transporte   Descontos em produtos     Igualdade de Oportunidades     Temos orgulho de ser uma empresa que oferece igualdade de oportunidades e progressão de carreira. Para isso, as decisões e oportunidades de emprego na Dori | Ferrara serão baseadas no mérito, nas qualificações e nas habilidades, independentemente da raça, cor, credo, religião, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade e expressão de gênero, estado civil ou união civil, nacionalidade, ascendência, cidadania, idade, condição de militar ou veterano, deficiência, informações genéticas, gravidez (parto ou condição médica relacionada) ou qualquer outra base proibida por lei.    A Dori | Ferrara não realiza cobranças para a participação de processos seletivos e toda a nossa comunicação é feita através dos canais oficiais da empresa. Se receber qualquer mensagem solicitando pagamento ou dados de cartão de crédito, pedimos que não responda e entre em contato imediatamente com nossos canais oficiais de atendimento (redes sociais ou SAC  ).    Em conformidade com a Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD), informamos que todos os dados pessoais fornecidos durante o processo seletivo serão utilizados exclusivamente para fins de recrutamento e seleção. As informações serão tratadas com confidencialidade, segurança e armazenadas apenas pelo período necessário para o processo, sendo posteriormente descartadas de forma segura.

Direct Response Video Editor (Remote - Brazil Preferred) $1,200-$1,400 USD/month + $250+ Monthly Performance Bonuses    We're an 8-figure DTC beauty & wellness brand generating $1M+ in monthly revenue through high-volume, high-converting video advertising. We need an elite video editor who understands direct response mechanics and can produce scroll-stopping ads at scale.    Your work will directly drive sales across Meta, YouTube, and emerging platforms—with immediate feedback from millions of impressions monthly.    What You'll Actually Do    High-Volume Ad Production (40-60 ads/month): Transform raw creator footage, UGC clips, and b-roll into persuasive short-form ads (15-90 seconds) and VSLs that convert cold traffic into buyers. You'll work across multiple products and funnels simultaneously.    Master Direct Response Mechanics:   Craft hooks that stop thumbs in the first 3 seconds (pattern interrupts, bold claims, visual glitches)  Deploy engagement disruptors: kinetic typography, callout graphics, progress bars, emoji reactions   Optimize pacing for platform algorithms (Meta 9:16, YouTube Shorts)  A/B test visual approaches based on performance data     Post-Production Excellence Color grading, sound design, motion graphics, and seamless transitions using Premiere Pro, After Effects, or DaVinci Resolve. Your edits should feel polished but authentic—not overproduced.     Rapid Iteration & Testing Partner with our Creative Strategist to test new concepts weekly. Expect fast feedback cycles and the need to pivot based on real-time campaign data. Speed + quality = your competitive advantage here.     AI-Enhanced Workflow Leverage tools like Descript, Runway, and AI caption generators to maximize output without sacrificing quality. We value efficiency and smart automation.     Top Fits Will Have:    Strong level of fluent English fluency (hard requirement) 2+ years editing for DTC/eCommerce brands (beauty, health, or supplements ideal)  Portfolio demonstrating direct response ads that drove conversions (show us your winners)  Expert-level proficiency in Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve + After Effects   Deep understanding of Meta/YouTube Shorts specs and algorithm-friendly editing patterns   Native fluency with UGC aesthetics (raw, authentic, relatable) vs. polished brand content   Proven ability to produce 8-12 ads per week without compromising quality   Ability to think critically and recommend new approaches, ad formats, and tools (outside the box)    Bonus Points:    Experience editing short-form VSLs (2-3+ minutes) or long-form VSLs (25+ minutes)  Motion design skills (After Effects, Cinema 4D)  Understanding of direct response copywriting principles   Familiarity with CapCut, Descript, or AI editing tools   Portuguese + English fluency     Non-Negotiables:    Fast turnaround times (24-48 hour revisions)  Self-directed work ethic in a remote environment   Obsessive attention to detail   Ego-free collaboration and receptiveness to feedback     Why Top Editors Choose Us:     Transparent Compensation Base salary + monthly performance bonuses tied to ad performance metrics. Top performers earn 20-30% above base.     Career Growth Path Start as Senior Editor → Lead Editor → Creative Director as we scale. We promote from within.     See Your Impact Daily Direct access to campaign metrics. You'll know exactly which of your ads are crushing it (and which aren't).    ️ Professional Setup Access to premium stock libraries, SFX collections, motion graphics templates, and AI tools. We invest in your efficiency.     Fully Remote + Flexible Work from anywhere with reliable internet. Core overlap hours with US Eastern Time for collaboration.     High-Volume Learning Produce more ads in 6 months than most editors create in 2 years. Accelerate your skills exponentially.     Application Process:     Step 1: Submit Application    Current CV/resume   Portfolio link with 3-5 best DTC ads (Vimeo, Google Drive, or YouTube unlisted)  Brief note (3-4 sentences) explaining which ad in your portfolio performed best and why you think it worked     Step 2: Paid Test Project ($100 USD) Top candidates receive raw footage + a creative brief to produce a 30-60 second Meta ad. Turnaround: 48 hours.     Step 3: Interview + Strategy Discussion 30-minute video call to discuss your creative process, workflow, and alignment with our brand.     Step 4: Onboarding Start with a 2-week paid trial producing live ads for our campaigns.     Applications without portfolio samples will be not be considered.     Good luck! We are excited to meet you!

Empresa está contratando Short-Form Video Editor em santa catarina. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Video Editor  Full-time – Remote    MenuFit is the #1 app for eating out healthy. Point it at any restaurant menu and it tells you exactly what to order to hit your macros and your goal — calories, protein, the whole breakdown — even for places that never published nutrition data.    We're #7 in Health & Fitness in the US App Store, rated 4.8 stars across 53,000+ reviews   , with 1.5M+ users   and 22.3M+ restaurant locations   covered.    Now, we're looking for a Video Editor to join our team!   You'll be responsible for editing video ads for Instagram, TikTok and Facebook, turning raw footage, scripts, and creative direction into  engaging, high-performing content   .    You'll work closely with our paid acquisition lead to adapt content for different platforms, test variations, and bring ad concepts to life. Your edits will play a key role in driving trials, conversions, and brand growth.    What You'll Do   Work closely with our Founder and Head of Paid Acquisition to bring our paid social ads to life across Instagram, TikTok and Facebook.   Edit  short-form video ads   using raw footage, voiceovers, and creator content, with a strong focus on clarity, pacing, and engagement.   Adapt content for different platforms and audiences, ensuring each video feels native to the channel.   Collaborate with creators, copywriters, and performance marketers to test multiple versions and hooks.   Use performance data and trends to  iterate quickly   — every creative here is judged on cost per trial and ROAS, and you'll see those numbers.   Help shape the look and feel of our ad creative, maintaining consistency with our brand tone and aesthetic.     What You Bring   You're a  highly creative and detail-oriented video editor   with a portfolio of short-form ad content that performs.   You have a strong understanding of  performance marketing   and how to edit for attention, emotion, and conversion.   You've created ads for Instagram and TikTok that actually convert.   You're comfortable working with  raw creator content   , motion graphics, text overlays, voiceovers, and you know how to use storytelling and experiment with new creative formats to keep content fresh, engaging, and high-performing.   You're  collaborative, fast, and resourceful   , with the ability to juggle multiple variations and work on tight deadlines.      Details   Full-time role   Location: Remote  $1200 - $1500 USD per month     Perks   Work directly with the Founder, the Head of Paid Acquisition, and a small, hungry team solving a real-world problem.   A product with  real retention, real revenue, and real impact.    Creative that ships fast and gets tested against real spend — you'll know within days whether an edit worked.     Ready to apply?  To apply for this role, please put in your application in this Google Form and we will get back to you. We look forward to hearing from you.

Com uma cultura baseada nos pilares  Comercial, Empreendedorismo, Excelência Técnica e Sonho Grande   , a empresa busca profissionais que desejam construir resultados e crescer no mercado financeiro.    Sobre a oportunidade     A oportunidade é destinada a profissionais em diferentes momentos de carreira:     Pessoas que desejam ingressar ou fazer uma transição para o mercado financeiro;   Profissionais com experiência comercial, financeira ou de relacionamento com clientes;   Assessores de Investimentos que buscam estrutura para ampliar sua atuação e desenvolver a carteira.     Buscamos pessoas com perfil comercial, espírito empreendedor, capacidade de relacionamento e ambição para construir uma carreira de longo prazo.    Principais responsabilidades     Prospectar novos investidores;   Desenvolver relacionamentos com clientes pessoa física e jurídica;   Construir e acompanhar uma carteira de clientes;   Compreender os objetivos, as necessidades e o perfil de cada investidor;   Identificar oportunidades e apoiar a construção de estratégias financeiras;   Atuar na captação de novos recursos;   Utilizar ferramentas de CRM e inteligência comercial;   Trabalhar com metas e indicadores de desempenho;   Construir relacionamentos de confiança e longo prazo;   Representar a marca Argentum no mercado.    ✅ Requisitos     Graduação em andamento ou completa, preferencialmente concluída;   Perfil comercial e facilidade de relacionamento;   Boa comunicação;   Iniciativa, organização e orientação para resultados;   Interesse genuíno pelo mercado financeiro;   Disponibilidade para atuação presencial em Porto Alegre/RS.    ⭐ Diferenciais     Experiência comercial, financeira, bancária ou consultiva;   Vivência com prospecção, negociação ou desenvolvimento de carteira;   Conhecimento sobre produtos e mercado financeiro;   Certificações do mercado financeiro;   Certificação ANCORD;   Experiência como Assessor(a) de Investimentos;   Carteira ativa de clientes.     A certificação ANCORD não é obrigatória para todos os perfis.   ✨ O que a Argentum oferece     Autonomia para desenvolver a carteira e as estratégias comerciais;   Formação prática e acompanhamento especializado;   Apoio e subsídio para a certificação ANCORD;   Tecnologia e ferramentas de CRM;   Mesas de operações, especialistas em produtos e backoffice dedicado;   Soluções em crédito, investimentos internacionais, previdência e carteiras administradas;   Possibilidade de crescimento e futura participação societária, conforme desempenho e critérios internos.     Modelo de contratação e atuação     Contratação na modalidade Pessoa Jurídica — PJ;   Estrutura de ganhos composta por componente fixo e comissionamento;   Atuação presencial em Porto Alegre/RS.     Os valores, as metas e os critérios de remuneração serão apresentados pela liderança durante o processo seletivo.     Você se identificou com esta oportunidade e se vê atuando neste modelo? Envie sua candidatura e venha construir sua carreira como Assessor(a) de Investimentos na Argentum.     Os profissionais com maior aderência à oportunidade serão convidados para uma entrevista inicial.

vagas.title: Regulatory Compliance Manager (Crypto)
vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Regulatory Compliance Manager (Crypto) em santa catarina. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Remote:   Brazil - Remote  Full time    About Revolut    People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.   As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.    About the role    Our Compliance team blends regulatory expertise with data-driven thinking to make sure our products meet legal and policy requirements and deliver real value to customers. In a fast-moving, digital environment, they stay one step ahead by finding smart, scalable ways to manage conduct risk.   We’re looking for a Regulatory Compliance Manager to keep our consumer protection practice in compliance. You‘ll advise on crypto compliance requirements and related controls.   Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch.    What you'll be doing    Developing and executing a world-class compliance framework, monitoring, and training programme   Supporting regulatory licence applications   Monitoring, testing, and reporting on the effectiveness of our regulatory architecture   Drafting, implementing, and rolling out compliance plans, frameworks, and policies   Providing expert regulatory advice to the Operations teams to support product launches   Collaborating with international product teams to navigate cross-border compliance requirements   Supporting the Head of Compliance in rolling out a robust compliance programme     What you'll need   4+ years of experience advising on compliance-related matters   The ability to analyse and interpret data to guide regulatory strategy   A solid understanding of the interplay between compliance risk and business risk   The ability to communicate positively with regulators and members of various internal teams   Excellent analytical skills with a proven track record of learning complex, new regulations quickly   Fluency in English     Nice to have    Experience working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment     Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.   Important notice for candidates:    Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.  •  Only apply through official Revolut channels.   We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.  •  Always double-check the emails you receive.   Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.   We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process.   If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.   By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

vagas.title: Email Designer
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Email Designer em santa catarina. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About Lilo Social   Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle: from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.    Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.    The Role    As an Email Designer at Lilo Social, you will be the creative force behind high-converting email experiences for our portfolio of direct-to-consumer brands. You will transform strategic concepts into beautiful, mobile-optimized email designs that drive engagement, revenue, and long-term customer loyalty. Working closely with retention strategists and copywriters, you will craft email templates that balance brand aesthetics with performance-driven design principles.    What Success Looks Like    Consistently high email engagement rates (open rates, click rates) across your client portfolio through strong visual design   Efficient production workflows that allow rapid iteration and testing of design variations   Email designs that maintain brand consistency while optimizing for conversion and user experience   Positive client feedback on design quality and strong collaboration with cross-functional team members     Responsibilities    Create campaign emails, automated flow templates, and promotional designs aligned with client brand guidelines   Develop mobile-first email designs that render flawlessly across email clients and devices   Collaborate with retention strategists and copywriters to bring campaign concepts to life   Iterate quickly on email designs based on performance data and A/B test results   Maintain organized design systems and asset libraries for each client account   Build reusable email modules and components that streamline production   Ensure all emails meet accessibility standards and deliverability best practices   Stay current on email design trends, platform updates, and industry innovations   Execute QA testing across multiple email clients before campaign launches   Support the team with design feedback and contribute to internal design standards   Manage multiple client accounts with varying design needs and brand aesthetics     Requirements   2-4 years of experience in email design, digital design, or related field with a strong portfolio demonstrating email work   Expert proficiency in Figma for designing email layouts and creating design systems   Strong grasp of email marketing best practices including mobile optimization, CTA placement, and visual hierarchy   Demonstrated ability to design for conversion while maintaining brand integrity and aesthetic quality   Fast iteration speed with ability to produce high-quality work under tight timelines   Excellent attention to detail and commitment to pixel-perfect execution across devices   Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with strategists, copywriters, and account teams   Familiarity with direct-to-consumer brands and ecommerce customer lifecycle marketing     Nice to Have    Hands-on experience with Klaviyo or other email service platforms (Mailchimp, Iterable, Braze)  Motion graphics or animation capabilities to enhance email interactivity and engagement   Experience designing for SMS, push notifications, or other retention marketing channels   Understanding of email deliverability factors and how design choices impact inbox placement     Compensation and Benefits    Fully Remote   : Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture   Time Off   : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance   Compensation:   Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

vagas.title: Analista de Logística de Artistas
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Analista de Logística de Artistas em santa catarina. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Analista de Logística de Artistas    Você ama música eletrônica, é organizado(a), gosta de resolver problemas e tem experiência com logística de viagens?    Então talvez essa oportunidade seja para você!  Estamos buscando uma pessoa para fazer parte do nosso time de  Logística   , atuando diretamente na organização e operação das viagens de artistas e suas equipes.   Aqui, você estará nos bastidores de cada show, cuidando para que todos os detalhes da operação estejam alinhados — desde voos, hotéis e transfers até itinerários, documentação, fornecedores e possíveis imprevistos ao longo do caminho.   ✈️ O que você vai fazer   Planejar e executar a logística de viagens nacionais e internacionais de artistas e equipes;   Realizar e acompanhar reservas de voos, hotéis, transfers e outros serviços;   Elaborar e manter atualizados itinerários e informações de viagem;   Fazer contato e negociação com hotéis, companhias aéreas, transportadoras e demais fornecedores;   Acompanhar toda a operação, garantindo que os serviços contratados sejam entregues conforme planejado;   Antecipar possíveis problemas e buscar soluções de forma rápida e eficiente;   Gerenciar alterações de última hora e situações imprevistas;   Organizar informações, documentos, rooming lists e demais materiais necessários para cada viagem;   Acompanhar custos e informações financeiras relacionadas à logística;   Trabalhar em conjunto com managers, artistas, produção, financeiro e demais áreas envolvidas na operação.     O que buscamos   Mais do que alguém que saiba fazer reservas, buscamos uma pessoa que  pense à frente da operação   .   Alguém organizado, responsável e atento aos detalhes, que tenha autonomia para conduzir suas demandas do início ao fim e consiga tomar decisões diante de imprevistos.   É importante ter:   Excelente organização e gestão de prioridades;   Forte atenção aos detalhes;   Perfil analítico e capacidade de resolução de problemas;   Proatividade e autonomia;   Senso de urgência e capacidade de trabalhar com prazos;   Boa comunicação verbal e escrita;   Capacidade de negociação e relacionamento com fornecedores;   Facilidade para lidar com múltiplas demandas simultaneamente;   Flexibilidade para lidar com mudanças de última hora;   Responsabilidade e senso de dono (ownership);   Capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente e remota.    ⭐ Será um diferencial se você tiver   Experiência prévia em logística de viagens, turismo, eventos e entretenimento;   Experiência com logística de artistas ou equipes de produção;   Conhecimento do sistema  Aboss   ;   Conhecimento de sistemas de reservas e ferramentas de gestão;   Experiência com viagens internacionais;   Inglês avançado;   Conhecimento de geografia, aeroportos e companhias aéreas;   Interesse ou experiência no mercado de música eletrônica.     Modelo de trabalho   Contrato PJ | 100% remoto    Buscamos uma pessoa que tenha autonomia e organização para trabalhar remotamente, mantendo uma comunicação próxima com o time e garantindo o acompanhamento das demandas e operações sob sua responsabilidade.    Se você gosta de estar nos bastidores, resolver problemas antes que eles aconteçam e fazer tudo funcionar para que o show aconteça, queremos conhecer você! ✈️

vagas.title: Produtor de Conteúdo Digital - Cirurgia Plástica
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Produtor de Conteúdo Digital - Cirurgia Plástica em rio grande do sul. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Produtor de Conteúdo Digital - Cirurgia Plástica - Creator    Arte Clínica | Bairro Petrópolis Porto Alegre | Presencial | Tempo integral   ----   Esta é uma vaga presencial.  Grande parte do trabalho acontece dentro da clínica e do centro cirúrgico. Se você busca trabalho remoto ou híbrido, essa vaga não é para você.    Buscamos uma profissional de marketing para integrar a equipe da Arte Clínica em expansão. A função abrange a produção de conteúdo para os perfis digitais da clínica, incluindo o Instagram do Dr. Daniel, o perfil institucional da Arte Clínica e o acompanhamento dos bastidores da equipe - com foco em cirurgia plástica tecnologias estéticas, fisioterapia pós-operatória e rotina clínica.   ----   Remuneração   bruta a partir de R$ 2.800 + variável por performance   Benefícios:  – Vale-alimentação: R$ 30/dia  – Vale-transporte ou auxílio combustível: R$ 413 – Cesta básica mensal por assiduidade e pontualidade   ----   Sobre a oportunidade    A Arte Clínica é uma das clínicas de cirurgia plástica mais reconhecidas do Sul do Brasil. Você terá acesso direto aos bastidores da clínica, trabalhando ao lado do cirurgião plástico pioneiro da técnica MIRELA no Rio Grande do Sul.   Essa não é uma vaga para quem quer planejar e delegar. É uma vaga para quem capta, edita, posta e acompanha o resultado - com autonomia e senso de urgência.   A função abrange os perfis digitais da Arte Clínica e do Dr. Daniel, incluindo bastidores da equipe, tecnologias estéticas, fisioterapia pós-operatória e rotina clínica.   ---   Como funciona na prática    Produzimos conteúdo diariamente (o volume de conteúdo é alto). Consultas, cirurgias, retornos, depoimentos e bastidores acontecem de forma contínua. Procuramos alguém que goste de ambientes dinâmicos e alta velocidade de execução.   Em dias de cirurgia, você estará no bloco cirúrgico capturando bastidores, depoimentos e conteúdo em tempo real. Em dias de consulta, você registra o dia a dia, edita e posta no mesmo turno. Semanalmente, você analisa as métricas do Instagram e traz sugestões por iniciativa própria, sem ser solicitada.   Você vai interagir diretamente com o médico, com pacientes e com parceiros externos como agência de tráfego e assessoria de imprensa.   ----   O que você vai fazer no dia a dia    Acompanhar consultas e cirurgias para captação de conteúdo   Captar vídeos, fotos e bastidores diariamente   Editar Reels e stories no mesmo dia da captação   Publicar conteúdos com consistência de horário   Registrar depoimentos de pacientes   Produzir antes e depois   Organizar banco de imagens e vídeos   Monitorar métricas e entregar relatório semanal   Apoiar campanhas e ações comerciais da clínica   Distribuir conteúdo para TikTok e YouTube Shorts    ---   O perfil que buscamos    Você se incomoda quando o alcance cai e age sem esperar que alguém perceba   Entrega no prazo e fecha o ciclo: capta, edita, posta, analisa   É criativa e traz referências ou ideias novas sem precisar ser provocada   Tem facilidade para ambientes dinâmicos com múltiplas demandas simultâneas   Presença em ambiente clínico ou cirúrgico não te intimida   Tem senso estético apurado e identificação com o universo da saúde, beleza e cuidado com o corpo     Buscamos alguém com autonomia para identificar oportunidades de conteúdo, executar e acompanhar resultados.   ----   Requisitos obrigatórios    Experiência comprovada na produção de conteúdo de Instagram   Experiência com edição de vídeo (CapCut, Premiere ou similar)  Produção de Reels e conteúdo curto   Experiência com captação de fotos e vídeos mobile, principalmente iPhone   Disponibilidade presencial em Porto Alegre, tempo integral   Familiaridade com ferramentas como CapCut, Canva, Notion e MLabs   Familiaridade com ferramentas de inteligência artificial como ChatGPT e Claude    ----   Diferenciais    Experiência prévia em clínica de saúde, estética ou cirurgia plástica   Uso de ferramentas de IA na produção de conteúdo   Conhecimento em métricas de Instagram e relatórios de desempenho    ----   Modelo de trabalho    Presencial, tempo integral   Regime CLT   Remuneração fixa compatível com experiência    ----   Cultura da Arte Clínica    Trabalhamos com alto nível de exigência, atenção aos detalhes e proximidade com o paciente. Buscamos pessoas que se movimentam por resultado, não por instrução.   ----   Como você será avaliada nos primeiros 90 dias    Consistência acima de 90% em stories e feed diário   Cobertura de bastidores sem solicitação constante  100% dos materiais captados com destino definido na mesma semana   Relatório semanal de métricas entregue sem cobrança   Mínimo de 8 sugestões novas apresentadas nos 90 dias    ----   Importante    Essa vaga exige presença real no dia a dia da clínica, inclusive em momentos de cirurgia e atendimento. Se você prefere um modelo remoto ou com baixa exposição ao ambiente clínico, essa vaga provavelmente não é para você.    Candidaturas: enviar portfólio para

vagas.description:

We’re hiring: Social Lead / Social Media & Community Manager   Earned Media Productions (EMP) is looking for someone who can  turn podcasts into growth engines — and build engaged communities around them.    This role sits at the intersection of  content distribution, social strategy, and audience engagement.     What you’ll do:  • Own daily posting across TikTok, IG Reels, YouTube Shorts, X, and more  • Turn podcast episodes into high-performing short-form content  • Decide what clips get posted, when, and where  • Manage comments, DMs, and community engagement across platforms  • Help shape the voice and presence of brands online  • Analyze performance and double down on what works    Key Responsibilities  1. Content Distribution & Posting   Own daily posting across all social platforms (TikTok, IG Reels, YouTube Shorts, X, etc.)  Manage scheduling, captions, hashtags, and formatting per platform   Ensure consistent, high-volume output of podcast clips   2. Podcast Clip Strategy   Turn long-form podcast episodes into a  structured content distribution plan    Decide  what clips get posted, when, and where    Collaborate with editors to guide clip selection and packaging (hooks, titles, formats)  3. Growth & Optimization   Analyze performance data to identify winning formats, topics, and hooks   Continuously iterate on posting strategy to increase:   Views   Engagement   Follower growth   A/B test captions, formats, and posting times   4. Platform Expertise   Stay on top of trends, algorithm changes, and best practices across platforms   Adapt content strategy accordingly (e.g., TikTok vs. Reels vs. Shorts nuances)  5. Systems & Organization   Build and manage a  content calendar + distribution system    Track posted content and performance metrics   Ensure no content bottlenecks between editing → posting → reporting   6. Collaboration   Work closely with:   Editors (to refine clips)  Creators/clients (to align on voice and goals)  Leadership (to align on growth strategy)    What we’re looking for:  • Experience growing social accounts (especially short-form video) • Strong understanding of TikTok / Reels / Shorts  • Someone who actually gets internet culture + audience behavior  • Ability to manage both  content output + community interaction    Must-Haves  2–4+ years managing social media accounts (preferably podcast or creator-led content)  Proven experience growing accounts through  short-form video    Deep understanding of TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts   Strong instincts for  what makes content go viral    Experience managing high-volume posting (multiple posts/day)  Fluent in English - Speaking and Writing.    Nice-to-Haves   Experience working with podcasts or long-form content   Background in content editing or scripting   Familiarity with tools like:   Asana/ Slack   Social schedulers (Later, Hootsuite, etc.)  Analytics tools   Experience managing multiple brands or clients    Bonus:  • Experience with podcasts or creator-led brands  • Background in content editing or scripting  • Experience building or managing online communities   This is a high-impact role with real ownership across content, distribution, and community.

vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Bolsista Graduado - FIEP - Metodologia de Gestão de Eventos da FIEP - Talento Inovação - IEL/PR em paraná. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

O Programa  Talento Inovação do IEL Paraná   tem como foco selecionar, acompanhar e desenvolver bolsistas, além de coordenar ações com organizações parceiras. Ele convida indústrias a proporem projetos de Pesquisa, Desenvolvimento e Inovação ( PD&I  ) nos quais a participação dos bolsistas promova o crescimento profissional em  PD&I   empresarial e contribua para a inovação da empresa.   O programa oferece bolsas para graduandos, graduados, mestres e doutores, permitindo atividades de  PD&I   nas instalações das empresas pelo território nacional, após aprovação da Comissão Interna do IEL Paraná.    Projeto   :  Desenvolvimento de Metodologia de Governança, Captação, Execução e Prestação de Contas para Eventos Estratégicos dos Conselhos Temáticos, Setoriais e Regionais da FIEP     Sobre a Oportunidade:     Inovação e melhoria contínua fazem parte da atuação da FIEP, e estamos em busca de talentos que queiram contribuir para o desenvolvimento de novas formas de gestão e mensuração de eventos estratégicos. Você terá a oportunidade de atuar em um projeto voltado à criação e validação de uma metodologia de governança para eventos, envolvendo etapas como captação de patrocínios, acompanhamento de contrapartidas, organização de informações, análise de resultados, prestação de contas e proposição de melhorias. Senior Business Analyst   Role Overview    The Information Management Team at our corporate client uses industry best practices to deliver analytical platforms, data management capabilities, and business intelligence solutions that support business needs. The team works closely with business stakeholders to understand their objectives, translate requirements into practical technology solutions, and improve the efficiency and quality of services delivered to customers.   The Senior IT Business Analyst will serve as the primary liaison between international business stakeholders and technology delivery teams. This person will be responsible for understanding business needs, documenting requirements, supporting solution delivery, and helping business and technical teams maintain a shared understanding of project goals.   The ideal candidate has strong business analysis and project delivery experience within an IT environment. Experience supporting data teams, data platforms, reporting initiatives, business intelligence solutions, or data-related projects is preferred. The Business Analyst should be comfortable working with technology teams and discussing technical concepts but is not required to be a hands-on technical specialist, developer, or advanced SQL user.    Principal Duties and Responsibilities    Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, technology teams, and project team members.   Lead and support requirements-gathering sessions with business stakeholders and subject matter experts.   Understand business objectives, processes, challenges, and desired outcomes.   Translate business needs into clear, complete, and actionable business and functional requirements.   Develop and maintain business requirements documents, functional requirements, process flows, use cases, user stories, acceptance criteria, and related project documentation.   Facilitate structured walkthroughs and reviews of requirements with business stakeholders and project team members.   Work with business and technology teams to clarify requirements, resolve questions, and maintain alignment throughout the project lifecycle.   Evaluate business requests to determine scope, feasibility, dependencies, risks, and potential solution options.   Support projects involving data, reporting, business intelligence, data warehousing, or information management.   Work with business stakeholders to define reporting needs, business rules, data definitions, and expected outcomes.   Assist business and technology teams in identifying data-related issues and documenting potential solutions.   Support the development and refinement of project backlogs, user stories, and acceptance criteria.   Participate in project planning, sprint planning, backlog refinement, demonstrations, retrospectives, and other Agile ceremonies.   Support user acceptance testing by developing test scenarios, coordinating business participation, documenting results, and tracking issues through resolution.   Assist with change management, implementation planning, troubleshooting, and post-production support activities.   Proactively identify opportunities to improve business processes, project delivery, service quality, and operational efficiency.   Encourage collaboration and help establish a shared understanding of evolving business requirements and project needs.   Communicate project updates, risks, decisions, dependencies, and outstanding issues to appropriate stakeholders.   Manage multiple assignments, priorities, stakeholders, and deadlines in a changing project environment.   Maintain regular and predictable attendance.   Perform other duties as assigned.    Job Specifications   Education and Experience    Required Education and Experience    Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.   Minimum of 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, IT Business Analyst, Systems Analyst, or Technical Business Analyst.   Experience gathering, analyzing, documenting, and managing business and functional requirements.   Experience working with business stakeholders and technology teams.   Experience creating user stories, acceptance criteria, process documentation, and business requirements.   Experience working in an Agile, Scrum, or similar environment.     Preferred    Experience supporting data teams or working on data-related projects.   Experience with data warehousing, reporting, analytics, business intelligence, data integration, or data management initiatives.   General familiarity with structured data, data quality, reporting requirements, and business rules.   Experience with reporting or business intelligence tools such as Tableau or BusinessObjects.   Experience with data modeling tools such as Erwin.   Insurance or financial services industry experience.   Six Sigma certification or process-improvement experience.     Skills and Abilities    Required    Strong business analysis, requirements-gathering, and documentation skills.   Ability to understand business processes and translate business needs into viable technology solutions.   Ability to work effectively with both business and technical stakeholders.   General understanding of technology projects, systems, data flows, integrations, reporting, and software delivery processes.   Ability to facilitate meetings, requirements sessions, workshops, and cross-functional discussions.   Strong interpersonal and relationship-management skills.   Strong investigative, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.   Strong oral and written communication skills.   Ability to explain business requirements and technology concepts to audiences with different levels of technical knowledge.   Ability to create clear user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and functional documentation.   Detail orientation and the ability to deliver accurate, high-quality work.   Ability to work effectively within an Agile team environment.   Ability to organize and manage multiple tasks, clients, projects, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously.   Ability to quickly adapt to new processes, systems, teams, and methods.   Ability to work through ambiguity and evolving requirements.   Ability to appropriately balance priorities, deadlines, risks, and project deliverables.     Technical Expectations    The Senior IT Business Analyst should be comfortable working in a technology environment and collaborating with developers, data engineers, architects, quality assurance professionals, and reporting teams. The position does not require the individual to be a developer, data engineer, or advanced technical specialist.   Basic familiarity with SQL, databases, reporting systems, data warehousing, or data analysis is beneficial, but the primary emphasis of the role is business analysis, stakeholder communication, requirements management, process understanding, and successful project delivery.

Build and actively hunt a prioritized funnel of target accounts with clear next actions, opportunity value, and design-win potential. Uma maneira de fazer negócios. Uma maneira de realizar.   Reagimos rápido. Nos adaptamos às mudanças.   Traçamos metas audaciosas e partimos para a ação.   É nisso que acreditamos. Essa é a nossa essência.   Chegamos até aqui porque cremos em nossos resultados e no nosso propósito de descomplicar a vida das pessoas.   Com uma liderança forte, visão audaciosa, cultura inspiradora e uma equipe composta de pessoas incríveis, formamos uma empresa pungente que pensa no coletivo.   Afinal, se um ganha, todos ganham. O que você pode esperar da Agrifirm?   Um ambiente colaborativo, ético, justo e respeitoso;   Cultura de crescimento e orientado para resultados;   Oportunidades de desenvolvimento e aprendizagem contínua;   Programas de capacitação e desenvolvimento profissional;   Atuação em uma empresa internacional presente em diversos países;   Uma cultura baseada em confiança, inovação, responsabilidade e trabalho em equipe;   A oportunidade de contribuir para uma cadeia alimentar mais responsável e sustentável. Role Overview   We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.   The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes.    Key Responsibilities    Business Development & Partnerships    Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers   Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered)  Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms)    Market & Network Development    Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa)  Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners   Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape     Execution & Collaboration    Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality   Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup   Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships     Banking & Infrastructure Setup    Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations   Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement     Requirements   5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management   Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services   Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners   Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets   Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics   Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM      Vision & Mission    OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.   OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

Requisitos desejáveis:   • Pós-graduação ou certificações em Governança de Dados, Inteligência Artificial, Gestão de Riscos ou Segurança da Informação.  • Conhecimento em MLOps, LLMOps, arquiteturas multiagentes, Model Context Protocol (MCP) e agent skills.  • Experiência com ferramentas de catálogo, metadados, observabilidade e governança de IA.  • Conhecimento em segurança aplicada à IA, incluindo riscos relacionados a prompt injection, data leakage e jailbreak.  • Experiência anterior em ambientes de missão crítica.  • Idioma Inglês avançado para eventuais conversações com fornecedores de solução.

vagas.title: Senior Sustainability Analyst
vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Senior Sustainability Analyst em santa catarina. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

This is Energizer Holdings, Inc.    Energizer Holdings responsibly creates products to make lives easier and more enjoyable. To do this, we lean into our culture as an organization – we win together, while serving each other, with a willingness to act boldly, all while doing right. Our colleagues hail from all backgrounds, nationalities and walks of life, but our shared mission and purpose make us one team. Because we’re a global organization, you will always have opportunities to learn, grow and develop in your career. We support flexible working arrangements wherever possible.    Position Summary     The Senior Sustainability Analyst plays a key role in advancing the company's sustainability strategy, reporting, compliance, and performance management programs. This position leads sustainability data collection, greenhouse gas (GHG) accounting, reporting, assurance, and audit activities. Working closely with cross-functional stakeholders across global operations, the role ensures data integrity, transparency, and alignment with corporate sustainability goals and external reporting requirements. The role also provides project management support for sustainability initiatives, including coordinating meetings, tracking action items, developing presentations and communications, and supporting implementation of strategic priorities and programs.    The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive, with experience managing complex sustainability data and reporting processes across multiple global facilities.    Responsibilities     Specific Accountabilities     Greenhouse Gas (GHG) Accounting & Emissions Management:    Lead global Scope 1, Scope 2, and applicable Scope 3 GHG inventory development, data collection, emissions calculations, and reporting.   Maintain GHG methodologies, documentation, and data quality in alignment with the GHG Protocol and regulatory requirements.   Partner with internal and external stakeholders to validate emissions data, support reduction initiatives, and ensure audit readiness.     Sustainability Reporting & Disclosure Management:    Lead project management and execution of the annual Sustainability Report, including timelines, stakeholder engagement, and approvals.   Coordinate content development, source documentation, communications, training materials, and website disclosures.     Assurance, Audit & Internal Controls:    Serve as the primary contact for sustainability audits and external assurance engagements.   Coordinate audit requests, maintain supporting evidence, and ensure effective reporting controls and governance.   Identify risks, implement corrective actions, and support successful completion of audits and assurance reviews.     Program Support:    Support implementation of evolving sustainability standards, frameworks, controls, and documentation processes.   Coordinate project meetings, stakeholder engagement, action-item tracking, and program documentation.     What we are looking for     Required Skills and Experience     Bachelor's degree in Sustainability, Environmental Science, Environmental Management, Engineering, Business, or a related field.   Minimum of 3+ years of experience in greenhouse gas (GHG) accounting, applying the Greenhouse Gas Protocol and related emissions reporting methodologies across multiple global facilities and operations.   Experience with external GHG emissions audits, assurance engagements, and verification processes.   Knowledge of sustainability reporting frameworks, regulations, and assurance requirements, including GRI, ISSB, CSRD, and related disclosure standards.   Proficiency with sustainability data management systems (e.g., Metrio) and advanced Microsoft Office tools, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, and SharePoint.   Strong project management, analytical, organizational, and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.   Experience supporting corporate sustainability reports, ESG disclosures, and cross-functional initiatives across global operations.   Professional certifications in sustainability, environmental management, or GHG accounting are a plus.     Come join us!    Energizer is an equal opportunity employer, and we prohibit discrimination based on age, color, disability, marital or parental status, veteran status, national origin, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other legally protected status in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws.

Who Are We?  Bueno Law is a trailblazing immigration law firm focused on empowering the Latin American LGBTQ+ community, survivors of domestic violence, victims of human trafficking, and other vulnerable individuals. We provide life-changing legal services to immigrants in the United States, and we’re looking for passionate, people-first individuals to join our remote team.    We specialize in:    Removal Defense (EOIR).   Asylum & Humanitarian Relief (U/T visas, VAWA, SIJS).   Family‑Based Immigration.     Your Role as a    The Case Assembly Drafter plays a pivotal role in preparing, organizing, and finalizing all components of a client’s immigration case prior to attorney review. This position ensures every filing is complete, accurate, and supported by required evidence. Ideal candidates bring exceptional attention to detail, strong writing skills, and the ability to manage multiple case components in a fast‑paced, mission‑driven environment.    Key Responsibilities     Drafting & Documentation     Draft cover letters for all immigration case types.   Prepare TVAP referral emails and attorney affidavits for T‑Visa filings.   Draft 918B cover letters for U‑Visa certifications.   Summarize FBI background reports for T‑Visa cases.   Draft country conditions reports and SIJS‑specific filings.     Case Assembly     Assemble complete case filings in PDF format following firm standards.   Ensure all forms, declarations, evidence, and supporting documents are included and properly organized.   Upload supporting documents and applications for online‑filed cases.   Submit finalized case packets for attorney review using Airtable workflows.     Client & Evidence Management     Collect client signatures on all forms and declarations.   Gather and upload psychological evaluations.   For SIJS cases, collect signatures on GC‑211s.   Verify completeness and consistency of all required evidence.     Quality Control & Accuracy Checks     Conduct credibility checks to ensure dates, timelines, and narratives align across all documents.   Confirm all mandatory documents are present before submitting cases for review.     Additional Responsibilities     Submit formal requests to hold cases in abeyance when appropriate.   Coordinate with internal departments to obtain missing documents or follow‑up information.     Required Competencies & Skills     Bilingual or professional fluency in English.   Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.   Ability to identify inconsistencies in client narratives and timelines.   Strong writing skills for drafting affidavits, cover letters, and formal requests.   Solid understanding of immigration case components and evidence requirements. Headquartered in Singapore with a global presence in Hong Kong, the UAE, and the US, we are looking for exceptional people to help us build an AI operating system that matters.    Join us and rewrite how the world engages at scale.    Associate Level    Location: Brazil    Prior Experience in SaaS/ Software Industry is preferred    Language: Spanish and business-level fluency in English     Responsibilities    Educating customers and optimizing their product setup for the quickest path to success.   Providing materials to help customers learn best practices to achieve their desired outcomes faster and more efficiently.   Work with sales, product, and support teams to ensure that each piece of the journey meets customer expectations.   Handle incoming enquiries via emails, calls and chats in a professional manner.   Build evergreen content and resources for customers (and other organizations) to use for education and to drive rapid product adoption.   Be a SleekFlow expert and discuss or educate on any nuance of the product internally and externally.   Work continuously to document the details of each interaction in order to easily research customer issues and to inform product improvements     Skills and Qualifications    Good command of both written and spoken Spanish and English   Minimum of 1 year of experience in communications, customer service and support, sales, account management, or customer success. Customer success courses / training are good to have. So however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come into work every day.

vagas.title: Mecânico Socorrista
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Mecânico Socorrista em rio grande do sul. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Descrição da empresa   barão transporte ambiental ltda é uma empresa focada em soluções de transporte voltadas à área ambiental, atuando com responsabilidade e segurança. a organização busca oferecer serviços confiáveis e de qualidade atendendo a demandas variadas de clientes públicos e privados. a empresa valoriza profissionais comprometidos com a preservação ambiental e com a manutenção adequada de sua frota. investir em segurança, manutenção preventiva e cumprimento de normas técnicas é parte importante da atuação da barão transporte ambiental ltda.  Descrição do cargo   o mecânico socorrista será responsável por realizar atendimentos mecânicos emergenciais em veículos da frota garantindo segurança e continuidade das operações. no dia a dia irá diagnosticar falhas mecânicas em campo executar reparos rápidos substituir peças realizar ajustes básicos e encaminhar o veículo para manutenção completa quando necessário, entre outras atividades envolvendo mecânica de veículos pesados e leves, também irá registrar ocorrências emitir relatórios de atendimento e apoiar a equipe de manutenção na organização das intervenções corretivas e preventivas. este é um cargo de tempo integral com atuação presencial em porto alegre rs exigindo disponibilidade para deslocamentos e atendimentos externos conforme necessidade operacional.   Qualificações    experiência prévia como mecânico socorrista em veículos leves e pesados com conhecimento em sistemas de freios, suspensão a ar, motor, caixa, diferencial e elétrica básica.   capacidade de diagnóstico rápido habilidade para atuar em situações de emergência e tomada de decisão segura em campo.   conhecimento em manutenção preventiva organização de ferramentas e boas práticas de segurança no trabalho.   habilidade de comunicação clara com equipe e motoristas registro adequado de informações e colaboração com demais áreas.   desejável experiência (fundamental) e curso técnico em mecânica automotiva de veículos leves e pesados ou áreas correlatas além de carteira de habilitação compatível com o atendimento à frota.
